rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is meant to last forever.

example.english: I hope our friendship can be everlasting.
example.traditional: 我希望我哋嘅友誼可以永遠維持落去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jau5 ji4 ho2 ji5 wing5 jyun5 wai4 ci4 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for something that keeps happening without stopping, especially when it is tiresome.

example.english: Those everlasting questions from the kid about when we would arrive were driving me crazy.
example.traditional: 嗰個細路不停咁問幾時先到，搞到我好煩。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 sai3 lou6 bat1 ting4 gam3 man6 gei2 si4 sin1 dou3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 faan4

rows.note: Use this for something that lasts a very long time without necessarily meaning literally forever.

example.english: For a relationship to be everlasting, both sides have to be willing to put in effort.
example.traditional: 呢段感情想維持得長久，雙方都要肯付出。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 gam2 cing4 soeng2 wai4 ci4 dak1 coeng4 gau2 soeng1 fong1 dou1 jiu3 hang2 fu6 ceot1
